name: AXM Governed Installer & Update Manager
actions: take in a returned build-on ZIP
compare it with its exact exported base
request an explicit digest-approved module install
roll back to the retained previous generation
summary: Receive an improved current-build ZIP, prove its base still matches, stage only the chosen module, preserve one previous generation, and expose post-install verification and direct rollback without granting automatic authority.
notes: Return intake is candidate creation only. Review approval is evidence, not install authority. Apply rechecks the exported base and candidate digest, requires module.install permission plus typed confirmation, and never auto-promotes or auto-rolls back. Post-install receipts prove only their exact installed candidate digest; drifted or unmeasured current bytes make the receipt historical and current verification UNKNOWN.
